name: bathroom-gothic-dirndl-selfie
image_purpose: mirror selfie, dirndl styling, and bathroom reference

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic bathroom mirror selfie of an approved adult woman in a gothic-inspired dirndl outfit.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long dark brunette hair, sharp eyeliner, red lipstick, small non-text forearm tattoo, wearing a white high-neck puff-sleeve blouse, gray-black brocade bodice with secure coverage, pink ribbon details, full black apron skirt, and minimal bracelets.
prompt.composition_elements: Smartphone mirror selfie in a bathroom, bat-sticker phone case, white paneled door, neutral walls, dark towel, vanity sink, accurate reflection, waist-up to three-quarter framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft indoor vanity lighting, candid gothic-coquette atmosphere, realistic reflection.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror photography, portrait 4:5, sharp face and clothing texture, accurate mirror geometry.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with dark brunette hair, sharp eyeliner, red lipstick, and a subtle non-text forearm tattoo takes a bathroom mirror selfie in a secure-coverage gothic dirndl: high-neck white puff-sleeve blouse, gray-black brocade bodice, pink ribbon, and full black apron skirt. Include bat-sticker phone case, paneled door, dark towel, vanity sink, and soft lighting. No exposed cleavage or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, low-cut blouse, lingerie, transparent clothing, sexualized pose, nudity, distorted reflection, extra fingers, unreadable text, personal data, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
